E1.evidence: Step-by-step reproduction (start rosbridge_websocket, subscribe to /mavros/global_position/global before mavros publishes, then start the stream), the resulting runtime warning, and `ros2 topic info --verbose` output showing the rosbridge_websocket subscription with "Reliability: RELIABLE" against the mavros publisher's "Reliability: BEST_EFFORT" -- https://github.com/RobotWebTools/rosbridge_suite/issues/769 . Maintainer closing statement: "Should be fixed now by #991, #1023 and #1033" -- https://github.com/RobotWebTools/rosbridge_suite/issues/769#issuecomment-2896918866

E2.evidence: rosbridge_websocket and mavros are separate processes that interact only through ROS 2 topics. The QoS reliability of the topic endpoints differs across the boundary: rosbridge 1.2.0 creates its subscription as "reliability=ReliabilityPolicy.RELIABLE," unless a BEST_EFFORT publisher already exists when it subscribes (https://github.com/RobotWebTools/rosbridge_suite/blob/1.2.0/rosbridge_library/src/rosbridge_library/internal/subscribers.py), while mavros publishes these topics with "auto sensor_qos = rclcpp::SensorDataQoS();" (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/blob/2.1.1/mavros/src/plugins/global_position.cpp), shown as "Reliability: BEST_EFFORT" in the reporter's topic info. Reporter: "Where we assume the default reliability policy is `RELIABLE`" -- https://github.com/RobotWebTools/rosbridge_suite/issues/769#issuecomment-1233642043 . The resolving change alters rosbridge's QoS selection code; it is not a name binding or build change.

E3.evidence: PAIR: mavros's output topics feed rosbridge's subscription. The failure needs the subscription to be created before the publisher appears: "When I start rosbridge and subscribe to a topic before the topic is available I receive the following error" -- https://github.com/RobotWebTools/rosbridge_suite/issues/769

E4.evidence: Observed: "[rosbridge_websocket]: New publisher discovered on topic '/mavros/local_position/pose', offering incompatible QoS. No messages will be received from it. Last incompatible policy: RELIABILITY" and "subsequent attempts to connect via rosbridge to the given topic don't return anything." -- https://github.com/RobotWebTools/rosbridge_suite/issues/769

resolution.summary: rosbridge_library's Subscriber defaults its QoS reliability to BEST_EFFORT when no publisher QoS is known (RELIABLE only when publishers are TRANSIENT_LOCAL), so a later BEST_EFFORT publisher is compatible (PR #991; refined by #1023; backported to humble in #1033). mavros is unchanged.
resolution.evidence: Maintainer: "Should be fixed now by #991, #1023 and #1033" -- https://github.com/RobotWebTools/rosbridge_suite/issues/769#issuecomment-2896918866 ; no one in the thread reports the fixed rosbridge working with mavros. Diff of #991: "-            reliability=ReliabilityPolicy.RELIABLE," / "+            reliability=ReliabilityPolicy.BEST_EFFORT," -- https://github.com/RobotWebTools/rosbridge_suite/pull/991/files

notes: The reproduction subscribes to /mavros/global_position/global (topic info shows the RELIABLE rosbridge subscription vs. the BEST_EFFORT mavros publisher on that topic), while the quoted warning names /mavros/local_position/pose; both are mavros topics published with SensorDataQoS, so both are listed. The rosbridge 1.2.0 selection logic ("infos = node_handle.get_publishers_info_by_topic(topic)" then "if any(pub.qos_profile.reliability == ReliabilityPolicy.BEST_EFFORT for pub in infos):") only adapts to publishers present at subscription time, which is why the order matters; the reporter traces the RELIABLE default to rosbridge PR #690. Two of the packet's fix references are consumer-side workarounds in third-party projects, not fixes to either unit: BCLab-UNM/dragonfly-controller PR #20 ("Proactively create mavros publishers to fix rosbridge default", creates BEST_EFFORT publishers on the mavros topic names so rosbridge sees them first) and josuah/pico-ice-ros2 commit 23935095 ("Work around a QoS bug upstream in ROS2"). No other composition is documented in the thread; later commenters report the same symptom without details.
